market_context.rationale_en: Today's KOSPI +3.10% and KOSDAQ +7.26% rebound is a technical bounce, but medium-term weakness (5d −5.77%, 20d −10.70%, 4w −4.61%) and high volatility (60d annualized +51~52%) persist. Foreign investors' continuous selling (10 days) and UK fund outflows (97 trillion won) explain capital exodus; holding 012750 also shows clear foreign weakness signals. While market analysts mention 'bottom confirmation possible,' it remains at signal stage, so reducing buy exposure while monitoring rebound momentum continuation is appropriate for the next trading day.
